'''Sylvestre F. L. Gallot''' (born January 29, 1948, in [[Bazoches-lès-Bray]])<ref>{{cite web|title=Gallot, S.|website=Library of Congress|url=http://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/n86007665.html}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Sylvestre Gallot|website=Aracne editrice|url=http://www.aracneeditrice.it/aracneweb/index.php/autori.html?auth-id=243353}}</ref> is a French mathematician, specializing in [[differential geometry]]. He is an emeritus professor at the Institut Fourier of the [[Université Grenoble Alpes]], in the Geometry and Topology section.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Annuaire {{!}} UMR 5582 - Laboratoire de mathématiques|url=https://www-fourier.ujf-grenoble.fr/?q=content/annuaire&projet=Th%C3%A8me+G%C3%A9om%C3%A9trie+et+Topologie|access-date=2020-08-20|website=www-fourier.ujf-grenoble.fr}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Sylvestre Gallot received his doctorate from [[Paris Diderot University]] (Paris 7) with thesis under the direction of [[Marcel Berger]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=78148|title=Sylvain Gallot}}</ref> Gallot worked during the early 1980s at the University of Savoie, then at the [[École Normale Supérieure de Lyon]] and the University of Grenoble (Institut Fourier).

His research deals with [[Isoperimetric inequality|isoperimetric inequalities]] in [[Riemann geometry]], rigidity issues, and the [[Laplace operator]] spectrum on [[Riemannian manifold]]s. With Gérard Besson and Pierre Bérard, he discovered, in 1985, a form of isoperimetric inequality in Riemannian manifolds with a lower bound involving the diameter and [[Ricci curvature]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Berger, Marcel|title=A panoramic view of Riemannian geometry|publisher=Springer|year=2007|page=319|isbn=978-3-540-65317-2|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=d_SsagQckaQC&pg=PA319}} (pbk reprint of 2003 original)</ref> In 1995, he discovered with Gérard Besson and Gilles Courtois, a Chebyshev inequality for the minimal entropy of locally symmetrical spaces of negative curvature; the inequality gives a new and simpler proof of the [[Mostow rigidity theorem]].<ref>{{cite book|title=A panoramic view of Riemann geometry|year=2007|page=484|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=d_SsagQckaQC&pg=PA484|isbn=9783540653172|last1=Berger|first1=Marcel|publisher=Springer }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Pansu, Pierre|authorlink=Pierre Pansu|title=Volume, courbure et entropie, d'après Besson, Courtois et Gallot|journal=Seminaire Bourbaki|volume=1996/97, exposés 820–834, Astérisque, no. 245, Talk no. 823|pages=83–103|url=http://www.numdam.org/item/?id=SB_1996-1997__39__83_0}}</ref> The result of Besson, Courtois, and Gallo is called ''minimal entropy rigidity''.<ref>{{cite arXiv|author=Connell, Christopher|author2=Farb, Benson|authorlink2=Benson Farb|title=Minimal entropy rigidity for lattices in products of rank one symmetric spaces|year=2001|eprint=math/0101045 }}</ref>

In 1998 he was an invited speaker with talk ''Curvature decreasing maps are volume decreasing'' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Berlin.<ref>{{cite book|author=Gallot, Sylvestre|chapter=Curvature-decreasing maps are volume-decreasing (On joint work with G. Besson and G. Courtois)|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. II|year=1998|pages=339–348|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011711000}}</ref>

*with G. Besson, P. Bérard ''Embedding Riemannian manifolds by their heat kernel'', Geometric Functional Analysis (GAFA), 4, 1994, pp.&nbsp;373–398 {{doi|10.1007/BF01896401}}

*with G. Besson G. Courtois: ''Volume et entropie minimales des variétés localement symétriques'', GAFA 5, 1995, pp.&nbsp;731–799
*with G. Besson, G. Courtois: [https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/ergodic-theory-and-dynamical-systems/article/minimal-entropy-and-mostows-rigidity-theorems/7B7F706676FAC80C728846B8A29AFF00 ''Minimal entropy and Mostow’s rigidity theorems''], Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems, 16, 1996, pp.&nbsp;623–649
*''Volumes, courbure de Ricci et convergence des variétés'', d'après [[Tobias Colding]] et [[Jeff Cheeger|Cheeger]]-Colding, [[Séminaire Bourbaki]] 835, 1997/98
